svg.aria-label: What wsl-spawner reads and what it changes. It reads WSL's own answers (the distributions Windows lists, which run, WSL's version); inside a running distribution, through wsl.exe as root, systemd, its journal, the units, the containers and its own notes, never starting a distribution or Docker's daemon just to read them; and on Windows, the sign-out scripts and the policy's wait, the sign-in program, and after a run that ended without its time, the event logs. It runs as you. It changes, inside each distribution you set it up in, a start script, two services and its notes; for you, the sign-in program and its settings and history; as an administrator, which Windows asks for, the sign-out hook in the local Group Policy and the policy's wait when it is too short. A stop gives every service and container its time.
